description: This file contains assembly code for the early startup and bootloader process of a MIPS-based system, specifically for the Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It includes routines for relocations, cache management, and jumping to the main loader code.

methods.name: ehb
methods.description: Defines a macro for executing a synchronization and hazard barrier instruction in MIPS assembly.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Entry point for the bootloader startup process, performing relocation, cache cleanup, BSS clearing, stack setup, and branching to the main loader routine.
